web_events.query: Federal Reserve speech this week monetary policy
web_events.answer: Based on the most recent data, Federal Reserve Governor Michael Barr expressed openness to a rate hike if inflation does not moderate quickly. Barr emphasized that inflation remains too high and has been for over five years, and if trends in the data do not show inflation moving towards the 2% target, decisive action to raise rates will be necessary. This statement reflects the ongoing focus of the Federal Reserve on controlling inflation and adjusting monetary policy accordingly.

web_events.query: China PMI economic data this week
web_events.answer: China's private Composite PMI rose to 52.1 in August, indicating a robust expansion in the private sector. The private services PMI also increased to 51.4, showing a faster pace of growth in the services sector. The private manufacturing PMI rose to 51.5, marking a two-month high and extending the current run of expansion to nine consecutive months.
